name: uta-shield
description: Provider-side firewall for MCP servers with bundled PhishGuard threat-intel. HMAC-SHA256 verified identity, IOC/campaign blocking on args and responses, per-agent rate limits, DLP masking, x402-ready metering, fail-closed JSONL audit. Zero dependencies, 58 kB, 85/85 tests. By AliceLabs LLC.

capabilities.name: lookup_ioc
capabilities.description: Look up an Indicator of Compromise in the PhishGuard feed. Returns campaign context, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and reputation verdict.

value.description: The indicator to look up (domain, URL, IP, SHA-256, email address, mutex, filepath)

kind.description: Optional explicit type hint; auto-detected if omitted

capabilities.name: check_url
capabilities.description: Check a URL against the PhishGuard feed. Resolves redirects and expands shorteners before matching.

capabilities.name: screen_text
capabilities.description: Screen free-text content (email body, chat message, web page, tool output) for indicators of compromise and brand impersonation. Returns matched indicators and a recommended action.

capabilities.name: shield_request
capabilities.description: Wrap an MCP call through the uta-shield firewall. The caller provides signed identity (HMAC-SHA256), the call payload, and the upstream target. uta-shield enforces ACL, rate limits, DLP, and threat-intel blocking on the request AND on the upstream response, then returns the result with an audit trail entry.

agent_name.description: Pre-registered agent name (assigned by operator during onboarding)

body.description: Raw request body (the signature is computed over this)

tool_name.description: The MCP tool name being invoked upstream (for ACL)

identity.rotation: Operator-issued secret per agent; rotated via admin endpoint

barter_terms.barter_endpoint: POST /barter/quote  →  { provided_capability, requested_capability, hours_offered, hours_requested, settlement: 'compute-credit' }
barter_terms.barter_settlement: off-chain bilateral credit memo (no money crosses borders); the receiver-side operator credits hours on the giver's account
barter_terms.barter_audit_trail: JSONL, same fail-closed log as billing

agent_skills.name: phishguard-url
